name: Seduced in Shizen
source:
Welcome to Shizen!

A city has been created with the express purpose of benefitting the natural environment, and one single building has been constructed within it.

Shizen Academy.

This is no ordinary school, but one for four lucky students to undergo a series of psychological tests in pursuit of a mystery prize.

At the end of each month, one student will be eliminated, until a single winner remains.

Could it be you?

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220601191045/https://cara-paws.itch.io/seduced-in-shizen]Itch.io[/url]]
